$comment: Hand-maintained facts the conformance checklist cannot derive from code. publicSamples: fixtures that are real public samples, not written for the test suite. mappingSource: the specification a parser's mapping follows, taken from the parser's header comment; formats without one show 'not recorded'. Validation layers are not listed here: scripts/conformance.ts derives them from planFor() in src/validation/plan.ts.

mappingSource.ubl: EN 16931-3-2 (UBL binding) as documented in the Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 syntax pages
mappingSource.cii: EN 16931-3-3 (CII binding) as documented by FNFE-MPE / FeRD for Factur-X and KoSIT for XRechnung
mappingSource.svefaktura: SFTI, Mapping of Svefaktura 1.0 onto EN 16931-1, v1.4
mappingSource.zugferd1: ZUGFeRD 1.0 (FeRD) CrossIndustryDocument syntax, urn:ferd:CrossIndustryDocument:invoice:1p0; no mapping document cited in the parser
mappingSource.fatturapa: FatturaPA 1.2.x (FPR12/FPA12) and FSM10 semplificata schemas (Agenzia delle Entrate); no mapping document cited in the parser
mappingSource.ksef: Ministry of Finance KSeF schemas FA(2), FA(3), FA_RR(1) (crd.gov.pl/wzor/...) and the KSeF documentation (CIRFMF/ksef-docs)
mappingSource.facturae: Facturae 3.2 / 3.2.1 / 3.2.2 schemas (Spain); no mapping document cited in the parser
mappingSource.isdoc: ISDOC 5.2 to 6.x schema (isdoc.cz); no mapping document cited in the parser
mappingSource.ebinterface: ebInterface 4.3 to 6.1 schemas (ebinterface.at); no mapping document cited in the parser
mappingSource.finvoice: Finvoice 3.0 mapping onto EN 16931 (Finnish Federation of Financial Services)
mappingSource.teappsxml: TEAPPSXML v.3.0 Implementation Guide and 'Empty INVOICES-structure with explanations' (Tieto)
mappingSource.e-arve: Estonian e-invoice (e-arve) 1.2 / 1.2.EN; no mapping document cited in the parser
mappingSource.eslog: e-SLOG 2.0 Electronic Invoice, Part 2: Document Composition (April 2018)
mappingSource.eslog-1: Not mapped: the eslog parser reads eSLOG 2.0 only
mappingSource.mydata: AADE myDATA InvoicesDoc XSD, invoice namespace v1.0 and income/expenses classification v1.0
